name: evaluation-movement
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT=$(ls -d {outroot}/E043/desk-tempho1995-seed1-sc10-*/ | head -1) ESK_DESK_CONFIG=research/overlays/desk_tempho_1995_seed1_sc10.json; {python} research/exp/movement_profile.py --keys-cache {cache}/gp_species_base --out {out} --tag t1995_sc10_s1; export RESEARCH_OUT=$(ls -d {outroot}/E043/desk-tempho1995-seed1-sc40-*/ | head -1) ESK_DESK_CONFIG=research/overlays/desk_tempho_1995_seed1_sc40.json; {python} research/exp/movement_profile.py --keys-cache {cache}/gp_species_base --out {out} --tag t1995_sc40_s1; export RESEARCH_OUT=$(ls -d {outroot}/E043/desk-tempho1995-seed2-sc10-*/ | head -1) ESK_DESK_CONFIG=research/overlays/desk_tempho_1995_seed2_sc10.json; {python} research/exp/movement_profile.py --keys-cache {cache}/gp_species_base --out {out} --tag t1995_sc10_s2; export RESEARCH_OUT=$(ls -d {outroot}/E043/desk-tempho1995-seed2-sc40-*/ | head -1) ESK_DESK_CONFIG=research/overlays/desk_tempho_1995_seed2_sc40.json; {python} research/exp/movement_profile.py --keys-cache {cache}/gp_species_base --out {out} --tag t1995_sc40_s2; cp $(ls -d {outroot}/E041/movement-profile-*/ | head -1)movement_t1995_ctrl_*.json {out}/
note: E043: movement 1902-2025 of the over-sampled models next to the controls
